main_text.p: vacillat pedibus, totus in ge-stum abivit Genius, Videtur aliquid velle innuëre, Quidlibet; Modo ne nobis impo-nat, vastas illas oceani ge-nas, alapis, quas ei Xerxes incussit, livorem suum debere. Sed leve sit singulares homines decepisse, quod subdam, populare delirium est, & ejusdem illius genii imposturis ac instinctui ascriben-dum est utique. Psyllorum gens, quæ circa majores Africæ Syrtes, sedem habuit, crebris ab Austro vento, damnis & cladibus accepti, nunc obtriti domorum arborumque strage, nunc arenarum, velut in fluctus quosdam se effe-

page.notes: Right-hand edge shows cropped text of the facing page (show-through/neighbouring page), not transcribed. Long s rendered as s; the word "stage" etc. as printed. Catchword absent; the last line "effe-" is a hyphenated word continuing on the next page.
